create_translation_dataset: create a TranslationDataset from parallel source and target text files with given fields
split_translation_dataset: split a TranslationDataset into train, validation, and test dataset objects using the splits class method
create_multi30k_splits: create Multi30k dataset splits for the WMT 2016 multimodal translation task with language extensions
create_iwslt_splits: create IWSLT dataset splits for TED talk translation and clean XML files to plain text
create_wmt14_splits: create WMT14 English-German dataset splits with BPE tokenized train, validation, and test data
